name: smwmusic-journey-separate-ways
title: Journey - Separate Ways
description:
For those of you looking to introduce a little DMCA into your romhacks, I give you Separate Ways by Journey. This port was originally requested by MmmDoggy for his aptly titled hack, Separate Ways. I might have overdone it a bit on the drum part, you're welcome.

Thunder SFX is disabled.
